notes: The owner, asked what he thought of the new UI architecture and told that only two of five verticals actually lived in it: "make it so, that is the direction I would like to go." Stock and Portfolios opened panels onto the shared canvas. Research, Analysis and Administration still painted one page that covered it. So the same gesture — click a rail row — had two different physics depending on which tab you were on, and opening the Calendar hid the book you were reading. That is the inconsistency this whole restructure has been removing, left standing in the third place. Research and Analysis n
